title: Spousal IRA, Explained Simply
custom_excerpt: How a working spouse can fund retirement for a spouse with little or no income.
meta_title: Spousal IRA Explained Simply | Thrifty Crew
meta_description: What a spousal IRA is, why it keeps a non-working spouse saving, the 2024 limits, and a real-dollar example of what it can grow into over time.
